statement: Digitimes reports that exploding AI server compute demand is accelerating data-center architecture upgrades, with co-packaged optics entering commercialization and Taiwan OSATs newly competing for silicon photonics packaging business.
why: New entrants chasing silicon photonics packaging work is a sign that optical interconnect capacity is being built out to relieve a networking constraint on large GPU clusters.

impact.mechanism: More packaging suppliers entering silicon photonics expands assembly capacity for co-packaged optics, which is needed to interconnect large accelerator clusters.

evidence.excerpt: Exploding demand for AI server computing power is pushing data-center architectures to upgrade at a faster pace, with co-packaged optics (CPO) and related solutions entering their [first year of commercialization]...

confidence.basis: Secondary source and only a paywalled preview snippet was accessible; no capacity, lead-time or dollar figures were retrievable to verify the claim.
